prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1035; do not mention it.)
text:
We represent the individual injured in the motor vehicle collision described below, which occurred when the other vehicle sideswiped our client while our client was changing lanes. Our client has sustained injuries that are the subject of ongoing medical treatment, and we expect a claim for compensation to follow.

Effective immediately, please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office. Do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person. If your insured or any representative of the insurer has already spoken with our client, please let us know so that we can address it.

Please provide written confirmation of the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy covering your insured, along with the declarations page and any other coverage that may apply.

We also ask that you preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, dashcam or telematics data, vehicle inspection and repair records, witness statements, recorded calls, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please treat this letter as a formal demand to preserve such materials.
